input:
<question>
Someone left the company and their CAD file is still checked out. How do I get it unlocked?
</question>
<passages>
[KB-101 §3] Unlock a CAD file that is checked out by someone else - If the person has left or is away
1. Open a ticket in the **CAD Vault Support** queue with the file name and the user shown in **Checked out by**.
2. A vault administrator can force an undo check-out. Their unsaved local changes are lost, so the administrator first asks the user's manager to confirm.

Never copy the file to a new name to work around a lock: that creates a duplicate part.

[KB-101 §1] Unlock a CAD file that is checked out by someone else - Unlock a CAD file that is checked out by someone else
A file stays locked while another user has it checked out. Only that user, or a vault administrator, can release it.

[KB-101 §2] Unlock a CAD file that is checked out by someone else - If the person is available
1. In the CAD vault client, right-click the file and choose **Properties > Checked out by** to see who has it.
2. Ask them to check the file in, or to choose **Undo check-out** if they made no changes.

[KB-103 §1] Restore a previous version of a CAD file - Restore a previous version of a CAD file
Every check-in creates a version. To go back:
1. Right-click the file and choose **History**.
2. Select the version and choose **Get this version**, then check it in as the latest.

Released files cannot be overwritten. To change a released file, start an ECO (see KB-201).

[KB-502 §1] Sign in to the PLM with single sign-on - Sign in to the PLM with single sign-on
The PLM uses company single sign-on. If you see **Access denied** after signing in, your PLM role has not been granted yet (see KB-501). If the sign-in page loops, clear your browser cookies for the PLM site and try again in a private window.

[KB-202 §1] Find where your ECO is in approval - Find where your ECO is in approval
Open the ECO and choose the **Route** tab. The current step shows the stage (Technical Review, Change Board, or Implementation), who holds it, and since when.

If it has been in one stage for more than 10 business days, use **Route > Send reminder**. If the approver is away, their delegate is shown under **Delegations**; the change coordinator can reassign the step.
</passages>
